sentences.en: Sellers and buyers are anonymous and very hard to recognize.
sentences.zh: 买卖双方都是匿名的，很难辨认。

sentences.en: An anonymous caller contacted the police to report a murder.
sentences.zh: 一名匿名来电者联系警方报告了一起谋杀案。

sentences.en: The person who donated this money wishes to remain anonymous.
sentences.zh: 捐赠这笔钱的人希望保持匿名。

senses.zh: lacking individuality, distinction, or recognizability 无个性的
